subject: Renewal + capacity increase: procurement gateway & PO timeline
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <procure@acme-corp.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Ravi Sharma <ctobuyer@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase request / procurement portal handoff

Hi Markus,

We're approaching renewal for our Redwood contract and need to coordinate a capacity increase (estimate: +40% token capacity for FY26) and a two-year term extension. Procurement would like to run this through our vendor portal so we can issue a PO and get finance sign-off. Can you confirm the following?

- Is the current SOW (v2) the latest? Please attach an updated SOW if available.
- We'll need a filled procurement questionnaire and any SOC2 evidence links.
- Target PO submission by 07/14/2025 to align with our quarter close.

I've attached the initial SOW draft we received from your AE and our standard questionnaire. Ravi from engineering is on copy for capacity sizing.

Attachments: ACME_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (pdf stub), procurement-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation
procure@acme-corp.com
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Elena Gomez <procure@acme-corp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Ravi Sharma <ctobuyer@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase request / procurement portal handoff

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. We're aligned on the timeline and can meet the 07/14 PO target if we run a short mutual action plan. Quick answers up front:

- SOW: attached is SOW_v3_redwood-edits.pdf (minor term language and capacity table updated).
- SOC2 & evidence: SOC2 report link: https://redwood-secure.company.com/reports/soc2-2024 (public link provided to Acme via secure token).
- Questionnaire: we'll fill the procurement-questionnaire.xlsx and return by EOD tomorrow.

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) 06/30 — Accept SOW edits & confirm capacity numbers (Markus + Ravi)
2) 07/01 — Redwood returns completed questionnaire & legal redline (Laura)
3) 07/07 — Acme confirms PO template & any commercial exceptions (Elena)
4) 07/10 — DocuSign push for signatures
5) 07/14 — PO submission and finance sign-off

Cc'ing Laura Bennett (Legal) to handle the redline and Sergío Alvarez (Customer Success) to validate the capacity plan and any ramp schedule. If you prefer, we can also onboard the deal through your portal — provide portal access instructions and we'll upload the SOW there.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <procure@acme-corp.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Ravi Sharma <ctobuyer@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase request / procurement portal handoff

Hi Elena and team,

I've reviewed SOW_v3_redwood-edits.pdf and made a few targeted edits focused on the term extension and data handling clauses. High-level notes:

- Two-year term: acceptable. We added a 90-day termination for convenience with a prorated refund clause — let us know if that needs tweaking.
- Data retention / logs: clarified that audit logs are retained per your SOC2 request; we can expose an export via your KMS/HSM as an add-on if required.
- Pricing: attached redline includes a step-up schedule for the +40% capacity starting month 1 of the new term.

I've filled out the procurement-questionnaire.xlsx (see attached) and included the pointer to our SOC2 report. We can upload the redlined SOW to your portal if you share the vendor upload link or portal ID.

Attachments: procurement-questionnaire_filled.xlsx (xlsx stub), SOW_v3_redline.pdf (pdf stub)

Next steps from legal:
- If Acme accepts the redline, please confirm any nonstandard PO language and we'll generate the final DocuSign envelope.
- If finance requires a credit schedule for early payment, flag that now and we'll route to Rev Ops.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Elena Gomez <procure@acme-corp.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Ravi Sharma <ctobuyer@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase request / procurement portal handoff

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the filled questionnaire. A couple of points from finance:

- Can Redwood accept our standard PO with the attached "Net60" payment terms? Our procurement system enforces Net60 unless an alternate payment schedule is negotiated.
- Finance is asking whether there's any promotional credit or discount for committing to the 2-year term + 40% capacity. A one-time onboarding credit would help get approvals through the FP&A committee.

We're sharing the vendor portal link here: https://vendorportal.acme-corp.com/upload/ACME-VENDOR-8921 (portal requires vendor registration; please let me know the vendor company email you use and I'll pre-approve.)

If you can confirm the PO/payment terms and any one-time credit by EOD 07/03, we can keep the 07/14 PO target.

Best,
Elena
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Gomez <procure@acme-corp.com>, Ravi Sharma <ctobuyer@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase request / procurement portal handoff

Team — summary and action items (internal):

- PO/payment terms: Laura to confirm whether Legal can accept Net60 as-is or request Net45 with a small early-payment discount. Laura, please advise by EOD 07/03.
- One-time credit: I'll escalate to Rev Ops for a modest onboarding credit (target: $12,000 credit) tied to the 2-year commit + 40% capacity. If Rev Ops approves, I'll confirm to Elena by 07/03.
- Portal upload: Sergio, please register the vendor account at https://vendorportal.acme-corp.com using vendors@redwood.com and upload SOW_v3_final.pdf and procurement-questionnaire_filled.xlsx once Laura signs off.
- DocuSign: if legal approves the redline, I'll create the DocuSign envelope and include the HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/ACME-EXP-2025-07.

I've added the relevant links and attachments to the HubSpot record and flagged the deal for priority processing. Elena — we should be able to confirm the credit and payment schedule by 07/03 and keep your 07/14 PO submission date.

Thanks,
Markus
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
